title: Independent Data-Integrity Verification for LLM-Driven Functional Coverage Closure in Hardware Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.21570v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents can write directed tests that close functional coverage, but coverage only shows that a state was reached, not that the data on the way there was correct. This is a long-known point in verification and we do not claim it as new. We describe a small coverage-closure agent that applies it to an LLM loop: coverage is read from the report that the simulation itself exports (cocotb-coverage YAML) and never taken from the model's account, and data integrity is checked by scoreboards that are separate from the model. On three architecturally distinct RTL designs (an asynchronous FIFO, a UART transmitter and an AHB2APB bridge) the agent raised coverage from 91.7%, 88.9% and 67.4% to 100% within its 8-iteration budget in every logged run, using one design-agnostic agent. translated_title: 面向硬件设计中LLM驱动功能覆盖率收敛的独立数据完整性验证
translated_abstract: LLM智能体能够编写定向测试来闭合功能覆盖率，但覆盖率只能表明某个状态被到达，并不能表明通往该状态的路径上的数据是正确的。这是验证领域早已广为人知的观点，我们并不声称其为新发现。我们描述了一个将该观点应用于LLM循环的小型覆盖率收敛智能体：覆盖率从仿真自身导出的报告（cocotb-coverage YAML）中读取，而绝不采信模型的自述；数据完整性则由独立于模型的记分板进行检查。在三个架构上各不相同的RTL设计（异步FIFO、UART发送器和AHB2APB桥）上，该智能体仅使用一个与设计无关的智能体，在每次记录的运行中均能在8次迭代的预算内将覆盖率从91.7%、88.9%和67.4%提升至100%。连接到FIFO基础测试平台的响应式记分板监视器还在作者自己编写的激励代码中发现了一个时钟域跨越（CDC）错误。该监视器尚未（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个带有独立数据完整性验证的LLM覆盖率收敛智能体，通过从仿真报告读取覆盖率并使用独立记分板检查数据正确性，仅用一个与设计无关的智能体就在三种不同RTL设计上将覆盖率提升至100%，并额外发现了一个时钟域跨越错误。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an LLM coverage-closure agent with independent data-integrity verification—reading coverage only from simulation reports and checking data via separate scoreboards—which used a single design-agnostic agent to raise coverage to 100% on three distinct RTL designs and additionally uncovered a clock-domain-crossing bug.
